d:
The Miami Heat have won six straight games! Watch the best plays from the win streak.
Miami’s sixth straight win came against the Bucks, 137-130, in Giannis Antetokounmpo’s first game against Milwaukee since his offseason trade. Giannis finished with 27 points, 14 rebounds and 9 assists, and Bam Adebayo added 26 points, including 21 in the first half, as the Heat led 74-48 at the break. Miami made a season-high 22 threes in the win to improve to 9-6.
